description: (0.5.0) The offline analogue of fed-010: a root whose derived_from exceeds max_fanout. Truncation, never silent: complete false, control max_fanout, the unadmitted entries in frontier, and a chain verdict no better than unknown (RFC-ACDP-0017 §6.1, §8.2).

input.note: B, C, D and E are all carried and verify cleanly.

expected.behavior: Only the first max_fanout DISTINCT entries in derived_from array order (B, C) are admitted; D and E join the frontier, sorted.
Linear chain A→B→C→D with max_depth 2: C (depth 2) is verified but not expanded; frontier [D]; control max_depth.
max_nodes 3 over A→[B, C, D]: A, B and C are admitted (BFS order, ascending ctx_id within a depth); D joins the frontier; control max_nodes.
A caller passing max_fanout 101 MUST be refused (RFC-ACDP-0017 §6.1 item 4); the verdict schema caps limits at the RFC-ACDP-0006 defaults.

notes: Behavioral in this Draft: the verifier builds the described bundle from real signed bodies (or the rcpt-001 / sig-003 test keys), runs verify_chain, and asserts the pinned stage values and verdicts. Pinned verdict digests replace these assertions at promotion (RFC-ACDP-0017 §14).
